name: Kinuta Angelina
source:
One of the esteemed instructors at Yoyogi Married Women's Academy.

Half-Japanese and half-American, she speaks fluent (though slightly questionable) Japanese, she occasionally misuses proverbs. 

Her cuteness and charm make her very popular among the students.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=106141&gc=gc] Getchu[/url]]
